mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tbl_alarm (username, alarm_type, gubn_id, message) VALUES (#{username}, #{alarmType}, #{gubnId}, #{message})
mapper.select: SELECT alarm_id as alarmId, username, alarm_type as alarmType, gubn_id as gubnId, message, is_read as isRead, created_at as createdAt FROM tbl_alarm WHERE username = #{username} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tbl_alarm WHERE username = #{username} AND is_read = false
